prompts.title: Nano Banana 2 照相亭连拍叙事提示词
prompts.description: 为 Nano Banana 2 设计的复杂叙事提示词，要求生成两张并排的照相亭连拍照片（共 8 帧），采用黑白风格。故事讲述一个人逐渐从自己的连拍中消失，并出现在另一个人的连拍中，重点在于保持面部特征的一致性及特定帧的内容呈现。
prompts.content:
CRITICAL: Preserve both people's facial features exactly as in the reference photos. Both must be clearly recognizable.

Create two vertical photo booth strips side by side on a dark red textured fabric background. Each strip has 4 square black-and-white frames stacked vertically with white borders.

The story: he gradually leaves HIS strip (right) and appears in HER strip (left).

LEFT STRIP:
Frame 1: woman ALONE, smiling at camera
Frame 2: couple TOGETHER — he has appeared next to her, they look at each other laughing
Frame 3: couple kissing, eyes closed
Frame 4: couple embracing, both smiling at camera

RIGHT STRIP:
Frame 1: man ALONE, smiling at camera
Frame 2: man ALONE, looking sideways toward her, as if about to leave his frame
Frame 3: the frame is almost empty — only a faint shadow or slight blur where he was, he has left
Frame 4: empty frame — just the photo booth background, no person, he is gone completely

All frames black-and-white, high contrast, slight film grain. Direct front flash, flat photo booth lighting. Both wear simple dark clothing. Tight framing — head and shoulders. Strips are separate, never merging.
prompts.translatedContent:
关键要求：请务必精准保留参考照片中两人的面部特征，确保两人均清晰可辨。

在深红色纹理布料背景上，并排创建两条垂直的照相亭连拍照片。每条连拍包含 4 个垂直堆叠的方形黑白帧，并带有白色边框。

故事梗概：他逐渐离开“他”的连拍（右侧），并出现在“她”的连拍（左侧）中。

左侧连拍：
第 1 帧：女性独自一人，对着镜头微笑
第 2 帧：情侣合影 —— 他出现在她身边，两人对视大笑
第 3 帧：情侣接吻，闭着眼睛
第 4 帧：情侣拥抱，两人都对着镜头微笑

右侧连拍：
第 1 帧：男性独自一人，对着镜头微笑
第 2 帧：男性独自一人，侧头看向她，仿佛即将离开画面
第 3 帧：画面几乎空无一人 —— 他原本所在的位置仅留下一道淡淡的阴影或轻微的模糊，他已离开
第 4 帧：空画面 —— 仅有照相亭背景，无人，他已完全消失

所有帧均为黑白风格，高对比度，带有轻微胶片颗粒感。采用正面直闪，平坦的照相亭灯光。两人均穿着简单的深色服装。构图紧凑 —— 仅拍摄头部和肩部。两条连拍保持独立，互不融合。

prompts.title: Nano Banana 2 巴洛克风格肖像转换提示词
prompts.description: 这是为 Nano Banana 2 设计的详细提示词，可将上传的参考图像转换为超精细的巴洛克风格油画肖像，在应用戏剧性的明暗对比照明和 17 世纪华丽贵族服饰的同时，精准保留主体面部特征。
prompts.content: “Using the ATTACHED REFERENCE IMAGE as the identity source, create an ultra-detailed Baroque-style portrait that preserves the subject’s exact facial identity, bone structure, proportions, and skin texture with absolute fidelity. The subject is positioned in a classical aristocratic portrait composition, facing slightly off-center with a calm yet intense expression, evoking psychological depth and authority. Lighting: dramatic chiaroscuro with strong directional key light from one side, deep shadow falloff, and subtle Rembrandt triangle lighting on the face. Background is dark, rich, and painterly, with soft gradients and minimal distractions. Wardrobe: opulent 17th-century aristocratic attire with luxurious fabrics such as velvet, silk, and brocade, featuring intricate embroidery, lace details, and gold accents. Materials must show realistic texture, weight, and light interaction. Rendering style: oil painting realism with visible brushwork, soft blending, micro-texture, and subtle canvas grain. Inspired by classical Baroque masters like Rembrandt. Camera & optics: medium close-up portrait, 50mm lens feel, shallow depth of field (f/1.8), sharp focus on eyes, smooth falloff. Color grading: warm golden tones, deep shadows, rich contrast, cinematic dynamic range. Focus on depth, realism, material fidelity, and emotional intensity. Ultra-high detail, museum-grade finish, rich painterly realism.”
prompts.translatedContent: “以所附参考图像为身份来源，创作一幅超精细的巴洛克风格肖像，确保绝对忠实地保留主体的面部特征、骨骼结构、比例和皮肤纹理。主体采用古典贵族肖像构图，身体略微偏离中心，表情冷静而强烈，展现出心理深度与权威感。光影：戏剧性的明暗对比，一侧有强烈的定向主光，阴影过渡深邃，面部呈现微妙的伦勃朗三角光。背景深邃、丰富且具有绘画感，带有柔和的渐变，干扰元素极少。服饰：17 世纪华丽的贵族装束，采用天鹅绒、丝绸和锦缎等奢华面料，配以精美的刺绣、蕾丝细节和金色装饰。材质需展现出真实的质感、重量感和光影交互。渲染风格：油画写实主义，带有可见的笔触、柔和的晕染、微观纹理和细微的画布颗粒感。灵感源自伦勃朗等古典巴洛克大师。相机与光学：中景特写肖像，50mm 镜头感，浅景深（f/1.8），焦点清晰聚焦于双眼，虚化过渡平滑。色彩分级：温暖的金色调、深邃的阴影、丰富的对比度、电影级的动态范围。注重深度、真实感、材质还原度和情感张力。超高细节，博物馆级成品，丰富的绘画写实主义。”

prompts.title: 用于 Gemini Nano Banana Pro 的南亚男性角色插画提示词
prompts.description: 一份用于生成高质量南亚男性角色数字插画的详细提示词，包含特定的审美要求，旨在对比 Google Gemini Nano Banana Pro 与 ChatGPT 1.5 的生成效果。
prompts.content:
"A high-quality digital illustration of a handsome South Asian male character with a well-groomed beard and stylishly swept-back dark hair. He is wearing a traditional cream-colored kurta with an intricate white embroidered neckline and a blue floral patterned shawl draped over his shoulders. The art style is a blend of clean semi-realism and watercolor aesthetic. The background features a vintage study setting with aged parchment papers, floating feathers, ink splatters, and a wooden desk with a quill and lamp. Soft, warm lighting with a focus on fine facial details and a scholarly, artistic atmosphere."

​Key Elements for Consistency:

​Art Style: Semi-realistic digital painting with watercolor textures.

​Color Palette: Cream, muted teal/blue, and earthy parchment tones.

​Motifs: Calligraphy papers, feathers, and ink blots to maintain the "writer/scholar" vibe.
prompts.translatedContent:
“一张高质量的数字插画，描绘了一位英俊的南亚男性角色，留着修剪整齐的胡须，深色头发向后梳理，造型时尚。他身穿一件传统的奶油色库尔塔（kurta），领口有精致的白色刺绣，肩上披着一条蓝色花纹披肩。艺术风格融合了简洁的半写实主义与水彩美学。背景为复古书房场景，包含陈旧的羊皮纸、漂浮的羽毛、墨迹飞溅，以及摆放着羽毛笔和台灯的木质书桌。光线柔和温暖，重点刻画细腻的面部细节，营造出一种学术与艺术氛围。”

保持一致性的关键要素：

艺术风格：带有水彩质感的半写实数字绘画。

调色板：奶油色、柔和的青色/蓝色以及大地色系的羊皮纸色调。

主题元素：书法纸、羽毛和墨点，以维持“作家/学者”的氛围。

prompts.description: 用于生成男性角色写实 3D 设计图的提示词，重点突出特定的时尚细节（Aimé Leon Dore 风格棒球夹克、金色人字纹项链）、高调照明以及诸如次表面散射（Subsurface Scattering）等先进 3D 渲染技术，以实现逼真的纹理效果。
prompts.content: A photorealistic 3D character sheet of a male figure with a sharp fade haircut and a meticulously groomed beard. He is wearing a heavyweight {argument name="jacket color" default="cream-colored"} Aimé Leon Dore-style wool varsity jacket with leather sleeves and a large "NY" chenille patch. Layered with a thick gold herringbone chain. Front orthographic and three-quarter views. Soft, global illumination with high-key lighting to emphasize PBR albedo textures. Intricate mesh detail on the knit collar, realistic skin pores, rendered with high-end Subsurface Scattering.
